users_fired_after_hired.name: users_fired_after_hired
users_fired_after_hired.value: "users"."fired_at" is null or "users"."hired_at" is null or "users"."fired_at" >= "users"."hired_at"

order_comments_payload_required.name: order_comments_payload_required
order_comments_payload_required.value:
("order_comments"."is_voice" and "order_comments"."voice_storage_key" is not null)
          or (not "order_comments"."is_voice" and "order_comments"."body" is not null and length(btrim("order_comments"."body")) > 0)

shifts_adjustment_metadata_required.name: shifts_adjustment_metadata_required
shifts_adjustment_metadata_required.value:
not "shifts"."is_manually_adjusted"
          or ("shifts"."adjusted_by" is not null
              and "shifts"."adjusted_at" is not null
              and "shifts"."adjustment_reason" is not null)

payroll_records_approval_metadata.name: payroll_records_approval_metadata
payroll_records_approval_metadata.value:
"payroll_records"."status" = 'draft'
          or ("payroll_records"."approved_by" is not null and "payroll_records"."approved_at" is not null)

payroll_schemes_fields_match_type.name: payroll_schemes_fields_match_type
payroll_schemes_fields_match_type.value:
("payroll_schemes"."type" = 'fixed' and "payroll_schemes"."base_amount" is not null)
       or ("payroll_schemes"."type" = 'hourly' and "payroll_schemes"."rate" is not null)
       or ("payroll_schemes"."type" = 'kpi' and "payroll_schemes"."base_amount" is not null
            and "payroll_schemes"."rate" is not null
            and "payroll_schemes"."kpi_target" is not null and "payroll_schemes"."kpi_target" > 0)
       or ("payroll_schemes"."type" = 'commission' and "payroll_schemes"."commission_percent" is not null)

payroll_schemes_amounts_non_negative.name: payroll_schemes_amounts_non_negative
payroll_schemes_amounts_non_negative.value:
coalesce("payroll_schemes"."base_amount", 0) >= 0
          and coalesce("payroll_schemes"."rate", 0) >= 0
          and coalesce("payroll_schemes"."commission_percent", 0) between 0 and 100

notifications_read_at_matches_flag.name: notifications_read_at_matches_flag
notifications_read_at_matches_flag.value:
("notifications"."is_read" and "notifications"."read_at" is not null)
          or (not "notifications"."is_read" and "notifications"."read_at" is null)
